title: Cafe order kit
about: A warm, rounded ordering system that makes a morning queue feel like a chat with the barista.
style: Soft rounded system on a 4-column phone grid with generous 20px gutters, 16px card radius and pill buttons; friendly semi-rounded sans character with large weights for prices; ground is a warm off-white, surface a slightly deeper cream, ink warm near-black, accent a single saturated hue used only for the primary button and stamps.
tagline: Your usual, ready when you are

title: Library lending app
about: A calm, institutional-but-warm kit for borrowing, renewing and finding books, built on a quiet shelf-like grid.
style: Orderly 8pt grid with narrow column rules and 4px radius, like index cards; serif-leaning text type for titles with a plain neutral sans for data; ground is paper white, surface a pale tint of the ink, ink deep cool near-black, accent a measured mid-tone used for availability and links.

title: Ferry timetable kit
about: Clear, tidal and unfussy: departures first, with a cool-and-signal palette that reads in wind and glare.
style: High-contrast signage logic: bold condensed grotesque character for times, tabular figures, 2px rules between rows, 2px radius; ground is cool light grey, surface white, ink deep cool grey, accent a bright signal hue reserved for delays and the primary action.

title: Clinic booking kit
about: A reassuring, unhurried booking flow with plain structure, big targets and gentle colour.
style: Spacious single-column flow with 24px margins, 12px radius, large 48px touch targets; humanist sans of open, rounded character at generous sizes; ground is soft white, surface a cool pale tint, ink deep cool near-black, accent a calm saturated hue for the one primary button per view.

title: Pottery class booking
about: An earthy, tactile booking kit with generous space and a handmade, slightly irregular edge.
style: Organic layout on a loose 6-column grid, wobbly-edged 22px radius shapes and hand-cut dividers; warm geometric sans with a soft serif for headlines; ground is raw clay-tinted off-white, surface a deeper sand, ink dark warm tone, accent a strong warm mid-tone used sparingly for stamps and buttons.

title: Festival guide kit
about: A loud, poster-like guide for stages, line-ups and meeting points that still works one-handed in a crowd.
style: Brutalist-leaning blocks with heavy 4px ink outlines, zero radius, offset hard shadows and oversized stacked headlines in an ultra-heavy extended grotesque; ground is flat saturated accent, surface white, ink pure near-black, a second tint of accent for highlights.

title: Money tracker app

style: Minimal layout on an 8pt grid with 20px radius cards, thin 1px hairlines, tabular figures in a clean geometric sans; ground is near-white, surface a pale tint of accent, ink charcoal, accent used for chart fills in tints so the whole palette recolours from one slot.
